findings.summary: Pager rule targets non-arrow buttons that are not rendered by the pager template.
findings.consequence: The scoped selector adds maintenance surface without affecting current pager behavior; future edits may assume these button styles are active when the non-arrow pager controls are anchors.
findings.evidence: The owned rule at line 1964 selects `.littb_pager .ctrl li:not(.arrows) > button`, but the current pager template renders buttons only inside `li.arrows` and renders the other pager controls as `<a role="button">` at lines 1779, 1782, and 1788. The matching disabled button rule at line 1973 is therefore also unreachable for the current DOM.
findings.recommendation: Delete the unreachable non-arrow button rules, or change them to target the actual anchor controls if there is intended behavior not already covered by the global pager anchor styles.
verification: Inspected app/pages/sök.vue template and owned style lines with nl/sed.
Searched current source for `.littb_pager` and related selectors with rg.

findings.summary: Navigator rules target buttons, while navigator controls are anchors.
findings.consequence: The scoped navigator button styling and selected-state rule do not apply to the current navigator controls, creating dead CSS parallel to the existing global `.navigator a` and `.navigator li a.selected` styles.
findings.evidence: The owned selectors at lines 1982 and 1988 target `.navigator button`, but the current navigator template renders `Visa alla` and facet controls as `<a role="button">` elements at lines 1813-1821 and 1824-1832. Existing global styles in `app/assets/styles/styles.scss` target `.navigator a` and `.navigator li a.selected`.
findings.recommendation: Remove these scoped `.navigator button` rules, or retarget them to `.navigator a` only if they intentionally replace the global navigator anchor styling.
verification: Inspected app/pages/sök.vue template and owned style lines with nl/sed.
Checked global navigator styles in app/assets/styles/styles.scss.
